CommunityApplications.Profile: Envoryx runs Docker-native development environments on your Unraid server: PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Go, .NET and Java projects with their databases, each in its own containers, managed from one web UI. This repository holds the Envoryx container template. The documentation is at https://envoryx.dev/docs/, questions go to the support thread in the Unraid forum (https://forums.unraid.net/topic/201077-support-envoryx-a-development-environment/) and bugs to the GitHub issues at https://github.com/envoryx/envoryx/issues.
